title: Simultaneous Equations: One Linear and One Quadratic
seo_title: Grade 11 Linear and Quadratic Systems Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Solve equations in two unknowns, one of which is linear and the other quadratic, algebraically or graphically.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 11 worksheets: simultaneous equations with one linear and one quadratic equation, by substitution and graphs. 100 questions with memos.
key_big: Substitute the linear into the quadratic.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Make y (or x) the subject of the linear equation.
  • Substitute into the quadratic equation and solve.
  • Substitute each x back into the linear equation to find y.
  • The solutions are the points where the line and the curve meet.

Examples

Example

y = x + 1 and y = x² − 1

x + 1 = x² − 1

x² − x − 2 = 0

Answer: (2; 3) and (−1; 0)

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
The wrong equationSubstitute the linear one into the quadratic one.
Only xFind y for each x.
The pairsKeep each x with its own y.
